question: Can Runtime build and measurement-validly certify a credential-free browser-based execution substrate whose task bank is NON-DEGENERATE — i.e., cold re-derivation and a retrieval-shaped comparator are demonstrably below the success ceiling (point < 0.95, Wilson 95% lower bound < 0.90) at high residual novelty (novelty_fraction >= 0.5), with a real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction and honest per-task counters (http_requests, retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts, excluding latency_ms/1000) — certified ARITHMETICALLY before freeze, so that readiness condition (2) holds before any four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY benchmark is funded?
hypothesis: A credential-free browser substrate operating on live sites with asymmetric discovery structure (one-time session/resource/schema discovery that a parameterized treatment can amortize) can be constructed such that: (H1) the task bank admits a novelty-stratified partition where at high residual novelty (novelty_fraction >= 0.5) both the cold re-derivation baseline and the retrieval-shaped baseline achieve success rate point < 0.95 and Wilson 95% lower bound < 0.90; (H2) the treatment interface (parameterized mechanism carrier from Product lane) is structurally executable on this substrate, demonstrating treatment liveness; (H3) the substrate produces honest per-task economic counters that distinguish treatment from comparators. This certification is a bounded substrate readiness gate, not a product promotion.
falsifier: Any of the following is an explicit falsification of the substrate readiness hypothesis: (i) the arithmetic dynamic-range certification (computed in DESIGN, pure arithmetic with no outcome measurements) fails to show both cold and retrieval baselines below the success ceiling at high novelty (point < 0.95 AND Wilson_lo < 0.90 at novelty_fraction >= 0.5); (ii) the treatment interface cannot be shown executable (treatment liveness fails) on a minimal task from the bank before freeze; (iii) the per-task counters cannot be produced for all three arms (cold, retrieval, treatment) on at least one task; (iv) the task bank novelty stratification is degenerate (e.g., all tasks have novelty_fraction < 0.5 or the high-novelty stratum is empty); (v) the substrate bring-up or capability ledger fails (required scopes: CAP-CHROMIUM-LAUNCH, CAP-LIVE-SITE-REACHABILITY, CAP-TASK-BANK-LOADER). Infrastructure or substrate failure maps to INCONCLUSIVE or MEASUREMENT_INVALID per decision_rule, not a scientific negative.

B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.description: Cold re-derivation baseline: for each task, a fresh browser context executes the task from scratch with no prior knowledge, no retrieved fragments, no parameterized mechanism. The agent must discover the site structure, locate the target resources, understand the interaction schema, and complete the task. This is the 'first agent explores' condition. Measured per-task success (binary) and economic counters (http_requests, verification_calls, repair_attempts; retrieval_calls = 0 by definition).
B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.scope_bound: This baseline is re-measured in this experiment on the certified task bank; it is not inherited from prior packets. The prior Product packets (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440, EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598) recorded cold=1.0 at novelty>=0.5 on a deterministic REST class; this experiment uses a live-site browser substrate where discovery is asymmetric work.

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.description: Retrieval-shaped baseline: for each task, a semantic retrieval system (embedding-based over prior successful trajectories in the same task family) returns the top-k trajectory fragments; the agent executes the retrieved fragments with parameter binding for the current task instance. This is the 'strong retrieval/RAG over prior trajectories' baseline required by Graph experiment requirements (SPIDER_MASTER_PROMPT.md section 13). Measured per-task success and economic counters (http_requests, retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts).
B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.scope_bound: This baseline is re-measured in this experiment on the certified task bank. The retrieval index is built from trajectories on OTHER tasks in the same family (leave-one-family-out or leave-one-task-out per prereg), so it tests genuine generalization, not memorization.

positive_control.description: Treatment liveness control: the parameterized mechanism carrier (provided by Product lane per readiness condition 1) executes successfully on at least one minimal task from the certified task bank, producing a valid bound_action and completing the task with verification_pass=true. This demonstrates the treatment is structurally live on this substrate, not merely a design artifact. The control uses a low-novelty task (novelty_fraction < 0.2) where the treatment is expected to succeed.

null_control.description: Task bank non-degeneracy control: the certified task bank must contain at least 10 tasks in the high-novelty stratum (novelty_fraction >= 0.5) and at least 5 tasks in the low-novelty stratum (novelty_fraction < 0.2). The cold and retrieval baselines on the high-novelty stratum must have arithmetic accept regions that are non-empty and non-trivial (i.e., the success ceiling is not already violated by the arithmetic certification itself). If the task bank is degenerate, the experiment is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not a scientific negative.
null_control.frozen_null_requirement: task bank non-degeneracy certified arithmetically before freeze

substrate.engine: Playwright 1.63.0 public API, Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (canonical sha256 8c599d43aec53f2460a31ae2f4af6bd863f8258b34ff519564bc5d4726bfaa1e), viewport 1280x720
substrate.sites: credential-free live sites only (no auth, no cookies, no API keys). Candidate sites: public API documentation (e.g., https://api.publicapis.org, https://docs.github.com/en/rest), public e-commerce catalogs (e.g., https://books.toscrape.com, https://quotes.toscrape.com), public data portals (e.g., https://data.gov). Final site list fixed in prereg section 5.
substrate.session_management: fresh browser context per task for cold baseline; shared context for retrieval/treatment only within a task family evaluation block
substrate.network: real network egress to live sites; no mocking, no synthetic responses, no local proxy cache for task execution (proxy cache only for readiness certificate)

task_bank.construction: Task families defined by semantic transformation type (e.g., 'search and extract first result', 'paginate and collect all items', 'filter by facet and extract'). Each family contains multiple task instances differing in target resource identifiers (search query, category, filter values). Novelty_fraction = 1 - (reused_actions / total_actions) where reused_actions are actions that match a retrieved fragment or parameterized mechanism from the same family.
task_bank.novelty_stratification: High novelty: novelty_fraction >= 0.5 (discovery-heavy tasks where the agent must find new endpoints/schemas). Low novelty: novelty_fraction < 0.2 (near-replay tasks). Strata sizes certified arithmetically in DESIGN.
task_bank.credential_free: All tasks executable without authentication, API keys, or persistent cookies. Session discovery (if any) is part of the task work.

per_task_counters.http_requests: count of HTTP requests issued during task execution (browser network events)
per_task_counters.retrieval_calls: count of semantic retrieval queries issued (0 for cold, >=1 for retrieval/treatment)
per_task_counters.verification_calls: count of explicit verification steps (DOM/assertion checks) after task completion
per_task_counters.repair_attempts: count of explicit recovery actions after a verification failure (max 3 per task)
per_task_counters.excluded: latency_ms, token counts, model calls — these are Product-lane economics, not Runtime substrate counters

measurement_validity.authorship_separation: The substrate (browser automation, task bank loader, counter collection) is implemented in research/runtime/ and research/harness/. The treatment (parameterized mechanism carrier) is provided by Product lane via a defined interface. The retrieval baseline uses a separate retrieval module. No component imports another's detection/scoring logic.
measurement_validity.no_synthetic_fallback: Any failed real probe (browser launch, navigation, network request, site unreachable) records UNAVAILABLE/ERROR with evidence and smallest unblocking action. No httpx/requests substitution for browser execution. Site failures reduce task bank size but do not trigger synthetic fallback.
measurement_validity.capability_ledger: One-command fail-closed bring-up (research/runtime/bringup.py + per-experiment bringup_contract.json) must exit 0 with all required scopes PASS before any task runs. Required scopes: CAP-CHROMIUM-LAUNCH, CAP-LIVE-SITE-REACHABILITY (>= 3 of 5 candidate sites responding 200), CAP-TASK-BANK-LOADER (task bank JSON loads and validates). Advisory UNAVAILABLE: BrowserGym, AgentLab, policy-model credentials, GHCR.

result_mapping.SUPPORTS: Dynamic-range certificate (A-DYNAMIC-RANGE-CERTIFICATE.json) shows: for high-novelty stratum (novelty_fraction >= 0.5), both B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED have arithmetic accept regions with point < 0.95 AND Wilson_lo < 0.90 at the planned per-task n. Task bank certificate (A-TASK-BANK-CERTIFICATE.json) shows high_novelty_tasks >= 10, low_novelty_tasks >= 5. Treatment liveness control (PC-TREATMENT-LIVENESS) passes (5/5). Per-task counters produced for all three arms on at least one task. Capability ledger all required scopes PASS. Pre-freeze preflights passed.
result_mapping.MIXED: Dynamic-range certificate passes for exactly one of {cold, retrieval} at high novelty (the other is at or above ceiling), OR task bank has high_novelty_tasks >= 10 but treatment liveness passes only on a subset of low-novelty tasks, OR per-task counters produced for only two of three arms. Interpretation localizes which comparator or arm is ceiling-bound.
result_mapping.FALSIFIES: Dynamic-range certificate fails for BOTH cold and retrieval at high novelty (both at or above ceiling: point >= 0.95 OR Wilson_lo >= 0.90), OR task bank is degenerate (high_novelty_tasks < 10), OR treatment liveness fails (0/5), OR per-task counters cannot be produced for any arm. status=COMPLETE with this outcome.
result_mapping.INCONCLUSIVE: Infrastructure/substrate failure prevents completing the certification (browser launch, site unreachable, task bank load failure, capability ledger required scope FAIL). Recorded per-component with smallest unblocking action. Never encoded as scientific negative.
result_mapping.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: Synthetic fallback used for any failed probe; capability ledger required scope FAIL not recorded as INCONCLUSIVE; treatment liveness not tested before freeze; per-task counters not implemented; dynamic-range certificate not computed in DESIGN (post-hoc arithmetic).

task_bank_requirements.novelty_fraction_definition: 1 - (reused_actions / total_actions) where reused_actions match a retrieved fragment or parameterized mechanism from the same family

decision_rule.pre_freeze_preflight_requirement: Dynamic-range certificate (arithmetic, no outcomes), task bank certificate, treatment liveness structural check, and capability ledger all pass before freeze.json exists
decision_rule.arithmetic_certificate_note: At n=15 (high novelty), the dual-threshold accept region (point < 0.95 AND Wilson_lo < 0.90) is k <= 14 (k=14: point=0.933, Wilson_lo=0.702). At n=5 (treatment liveness), k=5 required for structural executability. The certificate A-DYNAMIC-RANGE-CERTIFICATE.json materializes the full k=0..n table.

product_consequence_positive: If the substrate is certified non-degenerate, readiness condition (2) is satisfied. The Product lane may then preregister and fund the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY benchmark (cold vs retrieval vs treatment vs instructions) on this substrate with a valid dynamic-range guarantee. C-MEAS-VALID's construct boundary widens to include 'measurement-valid substrate for real-agent benchmark with certified dynamic range'. This is a bounded scope widening enabling downstream work, not product promotion.
product_consequence_negative: If the substrate cannot be certified non-degenerate (dynamic range fails, task bank degenerate, treatment not live, counters missing), then readiness condition (2) is unmet. The Product lane must not fund the four-arm benchmark on this substrate. The program must either (a) redesign the task bank to achieve dynamic range (different sites, higher novelty tasks), (b) redesign the substrate to expose more discovery work (e.g., multi-step session/schema discovery), or (c) accept that the current credential-free live-site class cannot support a non-degenerate benchmark and pivot the benchmark to a different substrate class. A MIXED result localizes which comparator or component is ceiling-bound and guides targeted repair.

estimated_cost.infrastructure: Playwright 1.63.0 / canonical Chromium, real network egress to 3-5 credential-free live sites. No model calls for Runtime substrate certification (model calls are Product-lane). Credential-free; no network egress beyond target sites.
estimated_cost.cost_note: Wall-clock includes bring-up, capability ledger, task bank certification, and liveness checks. The arithmetic dynamic-range certification is computed in DESIGN at zero runtime cost.

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing. This is the critical readiness gate (condition 2) that has been re-discovered as a failure across two Product packets (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440, EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598) rather than repaired once in the substrate lane. A SUPPORTS result unblocks the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY benchmark by proving the substrate can distinguish treatment from comparators at high novelty. A FALSIFIES result forces an explicit substrate or task bank redesign before any benchmark spend. The arithmetic certification in DESIGN ensures the decision rule is reachable before any episode runs, eliminating the program's recurring defect of frozen controls that cannot fire.

freeze_eligibility.decision_rule_reachability: PASS — The decision rule is purely arithmetic in DESIGN (dynamic-range certificate computed from planned n, Wilson formula, task bank stratification). No outcome measurements needed. The accept regions are non-empty: at n=15 per baseline per stratum, the dual-threshold accept region (point < 0.95 AND Wilson_lo < 0.90) is k <= 14 (k=14: point=0.933, Wilson_lo=0.702; k=13: point=0.867, Wilson_lo=0.621). The rule is reachable by a genuinely imperfect instrument.
freeze_eligibility.measurement_prerequisites: PASS — Prerequisites: (1) credential-free live sites identified and reachable (verified by CAP-LIVE-SITE-REACHABILITY preflight), (2) task bank JSON with novelty stratification defined and loadable (CAP-TASK-BANK-LOADER), (3) browser substrate operational (CAP-CHROMIUM-LAUNCH), (4) treatment interface defined and minimal carrier executable (Product dependency, readiness condition 1), (5) retrieval module implemented (separate from substrate), (6) per-task counter collection implemented. All are code/data dependencies that can be verified before freeze.
freeze_eligibility.baseline_identifiability: PASS — Baselines B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED are operationally distinct procedures (fresh context vs retrieval+bind) with disjoint retrieval_calls (0 vs >=1). They are identifiable from the per-task counters and execution traces. The novelty stratification is defined by a measurable quantity (reused_actions / total_actions) computed from execution traces, not by assumption.
freeze_eligibility.control_sensitivity: PASS — The non-degeneracy control (NC-TASK-BANK-DEGENERACY) is an arithmetic certificate on the task bank structure, not a runtime measurement that could ceiling-bind. The treatment liveness control (PC-TREATMENT-LIVENESS) uses low-novelty tasks where treatment is expected to succeed; it tests structural executability, not discrimination. The dynamic-range certificate is the discriminating control and is computed arithmetically before freeze — it cannot ceiling-bind because it certifies the *absence* of a ceiling effect.
freeze_eligibility.treatment_liveness: PASS — The treatment interface (parameterized mechanism carrier) is a Product-lane dependency (readiness condition 1). This experiment defines the interface contract in prereg section 6 and requires a structural liveness check (5 executions on low-novelty tasks) before freeze. A treatment structurally incapable of executing is a DESIGN failure caught at freeze_eligibility, not a scientific result. The Director mandate explicitly requires this.
freeze_eligibility.freeze_artifacts_bound: PASS — Mutable local dependencies bound by hash in freeze.json.artifact_hashes: (1) research/runtime/task_bank_loader.py (loads/validates task bank JSON), (2) research/runtime/credential_free_substrate.py (browser automation + counter collection), (3) research/runtime/per_task_counters.py (counter definitions and collection), (4) research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-37999040476/task_bank.json (the task bank itself), (5) research/experiments/EXP-RUNTIME-37999040476/retrieval_baseline.py (retrieval-shaped baseline implementation), (6) research/runtime/bringup_contract.json (capability ledger scopes). Product's treatment carrier is an external dependency (not in Runtime's code roots) and is verified via interface contract at liveness check, not hashed here.
